posts.post_subject: SPIE's sale on "milestone series," but not incl. holography
posts.content_md:
Hi - 

I just got a note from the SPIE that there's a 33%-off sale on all of their Milestone Series books.

The two SPIE books which I have relating to 3-D are really phenomenal, if you're into the key primary papers in the field (presuming you trust the editors, which in this case, I do). **BUT** they're not "milestone" books, so they're not on sale.

The Bjelkhagen / Caulfield [Selected Papers on Fundamental Techniques in Holography](http://spie.org/x648.xml?product_id=436130) isn't a "Milestone" book, so I guess it's not on sale. In any case, you might want to look at the table of contents - they've reprinted many, many excellent papers, starting with Gabor's.

Hmmm... so what was I thinking? The 3-D one I mentioned is [Selected Papers on Three-Dimensional DIsplays](http://spie.org/x648.xml?product_id=381006) by Benton, which I really learned a lot from. But, again, not a Milestone book.

Ah, well. In any case, [the 33% off stuff is here.](http://spie.org/x853.xml) (Note to readers in the future: this sale might have expired by the time you see this post.)

g
